relevant_laws.quote: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: Both intersecting highways are two-directional: The approach for a left turn must be made in that portion of the right half of the highway nearest the centerline thereof.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: left-turn approach position at an intersection of two two-directional highways
relevant_laws.notes: Actual highway/intersection status, original body approach, and meaning of nearest portion require source review; no legal verdict assigned.
